summary.en: Built an agent pipeline that turns a single supplier product link into a review-ready Shopify draft, now used in production by the store's operators.
summary.id: Membangun pipeline agent yang mengubah satu link produk supplier menjadi draft Shopify siap tinjau, kini dipakai di produksi oleh operator toko.

en: Designed the architecture around a strict split, the model makes only four judgment calls per product while deterministic Python handles every mechanical step, keeping output consistent even at low reasoning effort
Cut Shopify API traffic to two MCP calls per product by folding collections, both option links, and verification into a single aliased GraphQL mutation
Built a rule-by-rule verification gate that checks ten rule groups against the real product in Shopify before any run reports success
Normalised two supplier sources, Alibaba and 1688, into one extraction schema, working around client-side translation and anti-bot systems that fail with HTTP 200
id: Merancang arsitektur di atas pemisahan ketat, model hanya mengambil empat keputusan penilaian per produk sementara Python deterministik menangani setiap langkah mekanis, sehingga keluaran tetap konsisten walau usaha penalaran rendah
Memangkas lalu lintas API Shopify menjadi dua panggilan MCP per produk dengan melipat collection, kedua penautan opsi, dan verifikasi ke satu mutation GraphQL ber-alias
Membangun gerbang verifikasi aturan demi aturan yang memeriksa sepuluh kelompok aturan terhadap produk sungguhan di Shopify sebelum run mana pun melaporkan sukses
Menormalkan dua sumber supplier, Alibaba dan 1688, ke satu skema ekstraksi, menyiasati terjemahan sisi klien dan sistem anti-bot yang gagal dengan status HTTP 200
